title: Architecture Planner 2027
description:
A 120-page A5 planner made for architecture students: yearly and monthly calendars, weekly notes pages, a skills tracker, drawing-types and materials references, books and precedents, and the reminders you need to keep going. Your name is printed on the cover.

Delivered as a PDF of A4 sheets with two A5 pages on each: print it, cut every sheet in half and bind the pages into your own notebook. A tablet version (A5 pages) is included.
